reviewItem.question: Does "Fine-Grained RBAC for application `update` and `delete` sub-resources: The default behavior of fine-grained policies have changed so they no longer apply to…" mean a change to config-key:argo-cd|path=server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance|component=argocd-cm (behavior-changed)?

change.after: "update/delete policies apply only to the application itself"

proposed.statement: Starting in Argo CD 3.0, application `update` and `delete` RBAC policies no longer apply to sub-resources; the v2 behavior can be kept by setting server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance to false in argocd-cm.
